episodes.title: It's Summer and We're Running Out of Ice
episodes.summary: In a world not so different from our own, policemen wear masks to protect their identities so their loved ones can't be harmed by criminals. The 7th Kavalry, a supremacist group, emerges from hiding with a plan that threatens the world. And somewhere, the Lord of the Manor writes a play as squids rain down from the sky.

episodes.title: Martial Feats of Comanche Horsemanship
episodes.summary: Angela easily captures the man who claims to have murdered Judd, but soon doubts his guilt. Adrian's servants present The Watchmaker's Son, and the police move in on the Seventh Kavalry.

episodes.title: She Was Killed by Space Junk
episodes.summary: The former Silk Spectre, Laurie Blake, is asked by Senator Keene to investigate Judd's death. She soon learns that the circumstances surrounding Judd's hanging aren't what the FBI were told, and makes a call to Mars. Meanwhile, Adrian goes buffalo-hunting and receives a warning shot.

episodes.title: If You Don't Like My Story, Write Your Own
episodes.summary: Lady Trieu drops her anonymity to buy some land. Adrian obtains a new Phillips and Crookshanks, and Angela confirms her grandfather's identity.

episodes.title: Little Fear of Lightning
episodes.summary: Looking Glass' backstory is revealed, from where he was on 11/2 to his current-day activities... and his betrayal of a friend. Meanwhile, Adrian escapes his captivity but is rudely pulled back to reality.

episodes.title: This Extraordinary Being
episodes.summary: The true origin of Hooded Justice is revealed as Angela overdoses on Nostalgia.

episodes.title: An Almost Religious Awe
episodes.summary: Angela recovers from her Nostalgia OD, and the treatment mixes the memories of her own life with those of Will's. Laurie finds a 7K operative, and Trieu tells Angela about her plan to save humanity.

episodes.title: A God Walks into Abar
episodes.summary: When Angela met Dr. Manhattan, and the two of them try to make their relationship work. On Europa, Adrian gets a birthday present.

episodes.title: See How They Fly
episodes.summary: Angela, Wade, and Laurie face off against 7K and Cyclops, and Trieu reveals her plan within their plans.
